description: Fixed-layout low sheet/contact resistance from the CMOS5L min ITF, with nominal capacitance

assumptions.description: Use the source sheet and per-cut resistance bounds on unchanged drawn geometry
assumptions.reason: ITF geometry and dielectric variation are not imported by resistance components; these scenarios measure resistance sensitivity at nominal capacitance

assumptions.description: Keep compact-device models and their internal resistance laws unchanged
assumptions.reason: Interconnect sheet resistance and per-cut contacts apply only to regions owned by extraction, independently of compact-model process corners

assumptions.description: Map ContIntActiv to the separate extracted nSD and pSD contact rows
assumptions.reason: The ITF groups active contacts; process-spec RCM1NSD and RCM1NPD confirm equal limits for both implants

assumptions.description: Use the CMOS5L ITF TopVia1 resistance between Metal4 and TopMetal1
assumptions.reason: The process specification leaves that row tbd; each variant-specific ITF explicitly supplies both endpoints, 0.1764 µm² area and its per-cut resistance

assumptions.description: Pair the resistance bounds with nominal analytical capacitance only
assumptions.reason: An R-only sensitivity selection does not establish statistical correlation with low/high capacitance or a matching field-solver stack

assumptions.description: Keep diffusion regions as ideal device-terminal endpoints rather than importing the ITF Activ sheet term
assumptions.reason: These datasets cover every existing KPEX interconnect resistance row. They preserve the extraction boundary and do not add resistance inside compact devices

assumptions.description: Convert ITF RPSQ in Ohm/square and RPV in Ohm/cut to the milliohm units stored by KPEX
assumptions.reason: The imported numerical tables multiply each source resistance by 1000 while preserving the independently defined cut dimensions

history.reason: Enable explicit fixed-layout sensitivity without claiming a correlated physical process corner
history.summary: Import complete CMOS5L min ITF resistance rows
